cohort: Primigravida women were recruited for pelvic floor MRI scans.
finding: Vaginal delivery causes pelvic floor injury that shows some recovery over time but does not fully return to pre-pregnancy levels within 6 months postpartum.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery can cause pelvic floor injury that may gradually recover over time, though not fully to the pre-pregnancy level within 6 months postpartum.
